tool.name: @arcships/light-ocr
tool.installation: Isolated temporary npm installation only; no root dependency or lockfile change.

role.use: OCR candidate generation and visual-review cross-check only
role.canonicalEvidence: Localized card face plus human visual review
role.independenceCaveat: light-ocr and prior Paddle-derived candidates share PP-OCRv6 lineage and are not counted as two independent sources; OCR confidence or agreement never authorizes automatic metadata writes.

fullTemporaryEvidence.durability: Temporary full-output artifact; canonical reviewed values and relevant OCR candidates are preserved in b4-localized-card-face-review.source.json.

limitations: The package accepts JPEG, PNG, or decoded pixels, not WebP; 345 WebP inputs were decoded with ImageMagick 7 and bound by source and decoded SHA-256 before OCR.
No language hint, character-level coordinates, or text-line orientation was available in this run.
One engine instance is serialized; this run used the CPU provider and does not establish CoreML performance.
CJK punctuation and visually similar glyphs require manual card-face adjudication even at high confidence.
